summary: This page covers 5.4 (System Realization 525). OCR text begins with: 5.4 System Realization 525 For H[z], b0 = 1, b1 = 4, b2 = 5, and b3 = 2. Hence, we obtain the canonic direct realization, shown in Fig. 5.13a. We have shown the horizontal orientation because it is easier to see that this filter is basically a tapped delay line. That is why this structure is also known as a tapped delay line or transversal filter. Figure 5.13b shows the corresponding transposed implementation. C ASCA
